column1: # LidarTreeSegmenter - field measurement of a few trees (e.g. 5 trees with a Garmin GPS)
# Save a copy of this file as <scan_name>_field.csv, e.g. _S4v__r20_field.csv,
# in the scan's results folder (01_RAPORT) or next to the scan file, and run the report.
# Lines starting with # are skipped - you can delete them.
# nr        - your tree number (any number, it does not have to match the LidarTreeSegmenter numbers)
# lat       - latitude from the Garmin, e.g. 49.61234 or N49 36.740
# dbh_cm    - DBH (diameter at breast height, 1.3 m) in cm (important - trees are matched by it)
# Instead of lat/lon you can give the columns x
# You can also save the Garmin waypoints as <scan_name>_field.gpx
# (waypoint names = tree numbers) and enter only nr and dbh_cm here.
